system.longDesc:
Otherwise known as a silencer, suppressors dull the noise of gunfire. Gritty: A suppressor stops any flash of light from a firearm’s action, and halves the distance at which it can be heard. Pulpy/Cinematic: A suppressor makes a firearm almost impossible to hear outside any room it’s fired in, or beyond a 5-yard radius, whichever is smaller

Resources TN 13.
